LPC supervision and EMDR consultation for Texas therapists

Reem Glasco, LPC-S, has supervised associates since 2009. Online across Texas, trauma-informed, with IFS-informed EMDR at the center of it, and horses and trails when the work asks for more than a screen.

See supervision openings Read the Texas licensure guide

Finding Balance Counseling is the practice of Reem Glasco, LPC-S, in Austin, Texas. Reem has held Texas LPC supervisor status since 2009 and is an EMDRIA Approved Consultant, a NARM therapist and a Somatic Experiencing Practitioner. She supervises LPC Associates online statewide at $425 a month, consults on EMDR at $185 an hour, and runs mindful trail and equine retreats for therapists. Clients seeking therapy are seen by Reem or by the practice's associates.

Three ways therapists work with Reem

LPC supervision

Your 3,000 hours, supervised online anywhere in Texas. $425 a month, four hours, trauma-informed. One opening in spring 2027.

EMDR consultation

Hours toward certification with an EMDRIA Approved Consultant. $185, online, focused on IFS-informed EMDR for phases one and two.

Retreats and training

Mindful trail retreats, equine-assisted training, and ethics CEUs for Texas LPCs. For when the growth edge is yours rather than a client's.

The licensure guide

Every number on the Texas LPC path, the supervision rules most associates get wrong, and what to ask a supervisor before you sign. Free, no email required.

Hi, I am Reem

I have been supervising since 2009, and the associates I work best with want more than signed hours. They want to understand what is happening in the room, including what is happening in their own nervous system while a client is falling apart in front of them.

My clinical center is IFS-informed EMDR: processing that consults the protective parts of a person instead of overriding them. Somatic Experiencing sets the pace, NARM tracks the patterns underneath. That is what I teach, and it is what I practice.

I expect you to show up prepared, be honest, and tell me when something goes wrong. In return you get help building a practice, not just a log.

New to the associate path?

The Texas requirements are specific, and the part that trips people up is not the total hours. It is the floor on months, the split between direct and indirect, and the group supervision cap.

3,000 hours
Supervised experience required for full LPC licensure
1,500 of them
Must be direct client counseling contact
18 months
The minimum, no matter how fast you accrue hours
4 hours a month
Minimum supervision, with no more than half in a group
60 months
When your LPC Associate license expires, without renewal

Looking for a therapist rather than a supervisor?

Reem sees a small number of adults and young adults for developmental trauma, C-PTSD, anxiety, panic and depression. When her schedule is full, the practice's LPC Associates have openings, including at sliding-scale fees.

Not all of it happens in a room. Equine-assisted sessions run with the horses near Dripping Springs, and walk and talk therapy happens on a trail in central Texas.

Therapy at Finding Balance Equine-assisted therapy

Something to try before we ever meet

Longer out-breaths than in-breaths tell a nervous system it is allowed to stand down. One minute is enough to feel the difference, which is also the argument for teaching it to clients before you teach them anything else.

If the circle distracts you, ignore it and count: in for four, hold for two, out for six.

one minute
